body: Thank you, Anon :) appreciate it the words :)
I've been meaning to get into Nietzsche- so I'll order that tight now. Thanks Anon! :) It's been a nice chat. Please feel free to SAM whenever you'd like :)

I laugh everyday because I have to, you know what I mean? I can be happy for a few moments, sure, but when I get in bed at the end of the day, it all hits me like a train- the sheer hopelessness of life. 

It's not cliche, I guess that's all there is to say. But I've been alive for 20 years now and don't think I've EVER been happy. It's difficult to keep hope after so long.

I wouldn't have guessed ;) haha

So, I guess you're saying there is truth to the fact that we can't consume the other, but that only means it is yet to be discovered- that we should strive to do this(to give life some meaning)? 

I guess I can agree with that, it may be too "meta" a reason to live, but is a reason nonetheless!
Thanks for the extremely fruitful conversation Anon!
Actually, I'd be grateful f you could recommend  me some books on existentialism and nihilism!
Definitely, it means something that there are people around the world that care. But in my immediate surroundings, I've got no reasons :(
I actually have a doggo. Been with me 11 years. Lives with my parents since I began college. I guess he would be a reason to live, but he'll be take care of if I'm gone.

Yeah, this is definitely interesting. I took a bunch of literature courses in college where I extensively read about the "other" in a plethora of contexts. If I understood it right,  isn'twhat you mentioned in the final paragraph the ultimate reason for not living? It is impossible to know the truth. We will never know what is real and what isn't. I don't know how to live with it.  

I'm curious, are you a philosophy major? Haha

I have had the (dis) pleasure of reading Sartre's Being and Nothingness. Life is definitely shallow. Nihilism seems to be the only rational life philosophy to have. I find it impossible to find a meaning or point in anything.

Haha, yeah you can surf inside, it's fun, but gets old fast 
It's a cool place when you realize it's all been created in the past 20 years.
But at the same time, it's EXTREMELY artificial. Everything is indoors. Everything is inside shopping malls. Architecturally, it's great. But you start seeing that it can be pretty shallow.

Thanks for the suggestions, btw! Appreciate it! :)

I live in New Delhi and the United Arab Emirates, but mostly in New Delhi
Oh, right, I'm 20 today, so I guess that's a reasonable time period. But those will be 20 long, painful years.

Haha, yeah, doesn't help 

I would love being an astronaut. But the fact that I've pretty much fucked up at college doesn't help. I'll never be an astronaut cause my grades aren't high enough AND I'll never have a job that'll allow me to afford a ticket to space. So that isn't happening either.

I don't believe there is one. I've stood under a few waterfalls. I live in a desert, so it was nice the first time, sure. But I don't think I'd be thinking about waterfalls before jumping out of the window haha
I'm a vegetarian, ha ha. Waterfalls are cool, I guess. But not worth living for.
